opening.argument: The promotion goes beyond advice on earning money in GTA 5 Online. The description directs viewers to DigiZani for GTA cash and presents the seller as cheap, fast, and reliable. The speaker then gives viewers a code for 10% off an order at checkout. Together, those statements solicit a purchase of a digital asset and tie that purchase directly to the video. The evidence establishes the offer and the checkout incentive, without establishing whether anyone bought cash or what happened afterward.

citations.quote: For CHEAP, FAST and RELIABLE GTA Cash: DigiZani
get 10% off your order by using code FROLIX at checkout
